Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — next steps

Thanks for the call earlier, Diego. Quick recap from our side: Archway runs a retrieval-heavy assistant that spikes during business hours (~10:00–15:00 ET) with 250–400 QPS at peak and median RTT expectations around 200–350ms. Latency is important for user-facing flows; we can tolerate slightly higher latency for background batch jobs.

We'd like to do two things next week: a 45-minute technical deep dive (demo + architecture Q&A) and a dedicated capacity sizing session where we walk through our traffic patterns and target SLOs.

Availability: I can do Wed/Thu mornings ET (09:00–12:00). I'll attach a sample load profile to help with pre-read. Could you propose 2 slots that work for your team?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Engineering | Archway AI

- 60-min capacity sizing session focused on throughput, latency SLOs, and fallback policies — we will run a short exercise against your sample load.

Two slot pairs that work for our team (all ET):
1) Wed Sep 13, 09:30–10:15 (deep dive) and Wed Sep 13, 11:00–12:00 (sizing)
2) Thu Sep 14, 09:00–09:45 (deep dive) and Thu Sep 14, 10:30–11:30 (sizing)

- Ben, please prepare a short GPU footprint estimate for a baseline run: 250 QPS and 400 QPS, both for 512- and 1,024-token average contexts. Include an estimate for steady-state batch vs. low-latency interactive.

- Can we ask Archway to confirm their peak concurrency (concurrent requests) and typical prompt length distribution ahead of the sizing session? That helps us pick the kernel/quantization path.

I can take Wed Sep 13 option 1. If Archway prefers Thu, I can also do Thu option 2.
